plan.summary: This 1-4 block is the first build phase of a 12-week off-camp boxing plan. With only one S&C session each week, the work stays full-body and high value: power first, then main strength, then practical accessories, then a short conditioning piece. Week 1 is used to establish a training max for the main squat lift so percentage work can start in Week 2.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body and upper-body strength with simple explosive work and enough conditioning to support boxing without dragging down recovery.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and keep power output sharp while trimming extra volume if boxing load rises.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift more emphasis toward fast, crisp power and speed expression while holding onto the strength built earlier.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up in small jumps, then build to one hard but clean top set. Stop if technique breaks. This set establishes your baseline for future percentage work.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your training max.

performanceTarget.prompt: Beat this top set with better load or cleaner reps when this lift is retested in a later block.
